typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{Meeting Name} as string,
		{Start Time} as string,
		{End Time} as string,
		{Maximum Attendees} as string,
		{Address 1} as string,
		{Address 2} as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		{Postal Code} as string,
		Coverage as string,
		{County Name} as string,
		Notes as string,
		BrokerID as string,
		{Meeting Type} as string,
		{Meal/Snack Served} as string,
		Status as string,
		{Meeting Language} as string,
		PhoneVenue as string,
		{Products Categories Presented} as string,
		{Informal/Formal} as string,
		{Event Contact} as string,
		{Contact Phone} as string,
		{Contract Number} as string,
		{Meeting Room} as string,
		{Record Type Name} as string,
		{Venue Type} as string,
		{Venue Type Other} as string,
		Owner as string,
		{Webinar Template Id} as string,
		{Webinar Region} as string,
		Account_Management_ID as string,
		FILE_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	multiLineRow: true,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/ib_kpma_seminar_ca_*']) ~> inbound
source(output(
		RecordTypeId as string,
		{Record Type Name} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/meeting_record_type_id.csv']) ~> RecordTypeId
DerivedColumn3 split(isNull({Meeting Name})||isNull({Start Time})||isNull({Maximum Attendees})||isNull(BrokerID)||isNull({Meeting Type})||isNull(Status)||isNull({Meeting Language})||isNull({Record Type Name})||isNull(Owner)||(({Record Type Name} == 'KPMA Seminars')&&(isNull({Address 1})||isNull(City)||isNull(State)||isNull({Postal Code})))||(({Record Type Name} == 'KPMA Webinars')&&(isNull({Webinar Template Id})||isNull({Postal Code})||isNull(State)||isNull({County Name}))),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(rejectNull, data)
ConditionalSplit1@rejectNull derive(REJECT_REASON = concat(iif(isNull({Meeting Name})||isNull({Start Time})||isNull({Maximum Attendees})||isNull(BrokerID)||isNull({Meeting Type})||isNull(Status)||isNull({Meeting Language})||isNull({Record Type Name})||isNull(Owner), concat('ADF:Field contain NULL value: ', iif(isNull({Meeting Name}), 'Meeting Name, ', ''), iif(isNull({Start Time}), 'Start Time, ', ''), iif(isNull({Maximum Attendees}), 'Maximum Attendees, ', ''), iif(isNull(BrokerID), 'BrokerID, ', ''), iif(isNull({Meeting Type}), 'Meeting Type, ', ''),iif(isNull(Status), 'Status, ', ''), iif(isNull({Meeting Language}), 'Meeting_Language, ', ''), iif(isNull({Record Type Name}), 'Record Type Name, ',''),iif(isNull(Owner), 'Owner ',''), '.'), ''), iif(({Record Type Name} == 'KPMA Seminars')&&(isNull({Address 1})||isNull(City)||isNull(State)||isNull({Postal Code})), concat('ADF:Required Field Missing for KPMA Seminars: ', iif(isNull({Address 1}), 'Address 1, ', ''), iif(isNull(City), 'City, ', ''), iif(isNull(State), 'State, ', ''), iif(isNull({Postal Code}), 'Postal Code, ', '')), ''), iif(({Record Type Name} == 'KPMA Webinars')&&(isNull(Owner)||isNull({Webinar Template Id})||isNull({Postal Code})||isNull(State)||isNull({County Name})), concat('ADF:Required Field Missing for KPMA Webinars: ', iif(isNull(Owner), 'Owner, ', ''), iif(isNull({Webinar Template Id}), 'Webinar Template ID, ', 'Missing State || Postal Code || County Name')), ''))) ~> RejectReason
inbound derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> DerivedColumn3
Join3 select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Name = {Meeting Name},
		Start_Time__c = {Start Time},
		End_Time__c = {End Time},
		Maximum_Capacity__c = {Maximum Attendees},
		Address_1__c = {Address 1},
		Address_2__c = {Address 2},
		City__c = City,
		State__c = State,
		Zip__c = {Postal Code},
		Coverage__c = Coverage,
		County__c = {County Name},
		Note__c = Notes,
		Meeting_Type__c = {Meeting Type},
		Meal_Served__c,
		Status__c = Status,
		Language__c = {Meeting Language},
		Phone_Venue__c = PhoneVenue,
		Products_Category_Presented__c = {Products Categories Presented},
		Formal_Informal__c = {Informal/Formal},
		Meeting_Event_Contact__c = {Event Contact},
		Contact_Phone__c = {Contact Phone},
		Meeting_Contract_Number__c = {Contract Number},
		Presenting_Agent__c = BrokerID,
		Meeting_Room__c = {Meeting Room},
		Venue_Type__c = {Venue Type},
		Venue_Type_Other__c = {Venue Type Other},
		OwnerId = Owner,
		On24_Webinar_Template_Id__c = {Webinar Template Id},
		Webinar_Region__c = {Webinar Region},
		RecordTypeId,
		Title__c = {Meeting Name},
		Account__c = Account_Management_ID
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: false) ~> Select1
RejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
ConditionalSplit1@data derive(Meal_Served__c = case(isNull({Meal/Snack Served}),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean({Meal/Snack Served})),{Meal/Snack Served}))) ~> DerivedColumn6
DerivedColumn6, RecordTypeId join(ConditionalSplit1@data@{Record Type Name} == RecordTypeId@{Record Type Name},
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join3
DerivedColumn3 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_seminar_ca_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> curatedInbound
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_seminar_ca_Meeting__c.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Insert
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_seminar_ca_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> rejectOutput
